description: This file contains core lifecycle management functions for daemon services, including start, stop, restart, and uninstall operations, with configuration validation, systemd checks, token drift detection, and messaging.

methods.name: maybeAugmentSystemdHints
methods.description: Augments systemd hints with unavailability messages if systemd is not available on Linux.

methods.name: emitActionMessage
methods.description: Emits a daemon action message and logs it if not in JSON mode.

methods.name: handleServiceNotLoaded
methods.description: Handles the case when a service is not loaded, emitting hints and logging messages.

methods.name: resolveServiceLoadedOrFail
methods.description: Checks if a service is loaded, failing if the check throws an error.

methods.name: getConfigValidationError
methods.description: Performs a best-effort validation of the current configuration, returning issues if invalid.

methods.name: runServiceUninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a service, optionally stopping it beforehand and asserting it is not loaded afterward.

methods.name: runServiceStart
methods.description: Starts a service, with pre-flight config validation and handling of missing or scheduled outcomes.

methods.name: runServiceStop
methods.description: Stops a service, with optional handling if the service is not loaded.

methods.name: runServiceRestart
methods.description: Restarts a service, with config validation, token drift check, and post-restart actions.
